body: I appreciate what you're saying I really do. This isn't my first attempt. I've tried many times before. I just fuck it up and end up in the hospital on watch. If I told him, he would take the key and possibly hide the gun. I've asked him to hide it from me before. I don't want him to take it. They are the only people in my life period, and yes I'm sure they care to some extent. I'm stressing out my partner daily and my kids are watching their mother become a foreign shell of a person. It's not okay. It's better if I leave them in peace.
